name: coupon-input
title: Coupon Input
description: Cleans pasted spaces, hidden characters and case, catches O-vs-0 look-alikes with a fix, says why a code didn't apply (cart minimum and the gap, expiry, excluded items, already used), shows the real saving and any cap, and asks before a worse code replaces a better one.

meta.summary: Cleans and checks a coupon code and says exactly why it didn't apply, so shoppers don't give up on a code that should work.
meta.server: Validate and price coupons on the server; never trust a discount computed in the browser.
catches: Pasted spaces, hidden characters and wrong case
Look-alike characters (O/0, I/1) against known codes
The specific reason a code was rejected, such as the amount still needed
A capped discount, shown as the real saving
A worse code replacing a better one
limits: Look-alike suggestions need knownCodes; otherwise it only cleans
Validity and rejection reasons come from your onApply
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the status
Enter applies; suggestion and remove buttons have aria-labels
Focus returns to the input after actions
